INSERT INTO api_access_log ( event_id, trace_id, request_time, method, uri, route, query_string, client_ip, user_agent, referer, http_status, success, cost_ms, exception_type ) VALUES
( #{log.eventId}, #{log.traceId}, #{log.requestTime}, #{log.method}, #{log.uri}, #{log.route}, #{log.queryString}, #{log.clientIp}, #{log.userAgent}, #{log.referer}, #{log.httpStatus}, #{log.success}, #{log.costMs}, #{log.exceptionType} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
